title: Event Streaming Platform (Kafka-lite)
description: A Java/Kafka clickstream pipeline validates schemas, runs Kafka Streams aggregations, and serves materialized views.
problem_solved: Trace events through schema validation, Kafka topics, stream processing, state stores, and query APIs while distinguishing the local fake registry from a real registry.
target_audience: Advanced beginner/intermediate Cloud and DevOps learners
prerequisites: Read the project's source tree and setup guide
Use disposable local/test environments for operational exercises
learning_outcomes: Explain the source system's implemented components and limitations
Trace data/control flow through modules and interfaces
Distinguish simulation, local implementation, and external production services
Use tests, logs, and safe experiments to verify claims
Apply security, operational, and failure-mode reasoning
